blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists will breathe a sigh of relief next week as fuel prices may drop amid renewed optimism that the Middle East war will end after Democrats won control of the United States (US) Congress. Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas said gasoline prices may significantly drop by P12.50 to P13.50 per liter starting Nov. 10. READ: US midterm vote delivers strong rebuke of Trump Diesel prices will be cut ranging from P4.30 to P4.50 per liter.
